name: schema-loss-audit-taxonomy-map-processing-flow-admin-cleanup
note: Phase 0-D is read-only against every FROZEN artifact and every Phase-0-C-owned reconciliation/canonical file. Phase 0-D ships four WPs (WP-ADMIN-CLEANUP-01, WP-TAXONOMY-MAP-01, WP-PROCESSING-FLOW-MAP-01, WP-SCHEMA-LOSS-AUDIT-01) that render existing sources of truth and detect loss; no phase-0-D work may edit the sources themselves. Reviewer decisions from WP-SCHEMA-LOSS-AUDIT-01 re-open upstream freeze gates per Section 2.7 but never write to a FROZEN file directly. The Taxonomy and Processing-Flow markdown files are in the allowed list only because the map pages need to render them and may commit rendered-svg companions; edits to their prose remain reviewer-authored through the Freeze Gate PR mechanism (Codex may not mutate them mid-phase). archive/strings-reviewer/** is allowed because PR #141's preserved reviewer UI folds into Phase 0-D scope (see WP-ADMIN-CLEANUP-01).
